controls.source_trace: Bootstrap defaults -> persisted settings -> upgrade/restore override.
controls.controlled_verification: Observe fresh disposable instance and relevant upgrade state separately.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A securely configured existing instance does not prove secure defaults.
controls.remediation_acceptance: New instances start restricted and historical insecure persisted state is addressed explicitly.

controls.source_trace: Declared config -> environment -> runtime override -> active value.
controls.controlled_verification: Compare the known route behavior with effective deployment settings.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Unused sample files and overridden fragments are not proof of runtime exposure.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Change authoritative config and verify fresh deployment plus override behavior.

controls.source_trace: Diagnostics/debug route registration -> ingress reachability -> auth policy.
controls.controlled_verification: Request a known in-scope diagnostic route and a controlled error.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A generic error or version banner alone may not expose a protected capability.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Restrict administrative surfaces; client errors avoid secrets while operator correlation remains.

controls.source_trace: Proxy trust config -> caller IP/host/origin interpretation -> sensitive decision.
controls.controlled_verification: Use controlled requests within the documented ingress model; compare spoofed and trusted context.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Trusted proxy values may be legitimate only on the actual trusted hop.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Untrusted direct callers cannot override security-relevant origin/address context.

controls.source_trace: XML/format parser construction -> external resolution/expansion flags -> input.
controls.controlled_verification: Use an inert local fixture to observe prohibited feature activation.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Feature names in dependencies do not prove enabled runtime behavior.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Disable unnecessary unsafe capabilities and verify supported legitimate documents.

controls.source_trace: Effective resource permissions/response directives -> consumer -> protected asset.
controls.controlled_verification: Evaluate actual policy and minimal known fixture access; inspect browser context as relevant.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: Missing headers and permissive fragments need context and effective deny-rule evaluation.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Required exposure boundaries hold after redeploy; permitted content remains usable.
